Matchstick Productions returns with their 34th annual ski film, The Way Out, a raw tribute to the timeless culture and lifestyle of skiing. Dropping you straight into heavy Alaskan spine lines, deep Japanese powder, and iconic Swiss villages. This film shows skiing as far more than a sport; it's a path toward total freedom. event.title: August Wilson’s Two Trains Running — AURORA FOX ARTS CENTER
event.description:
#### **Feb. 4 to 21, 2027 \| Aurora Fox Mainstage**

Directed by donnie l. betts, this compelling production marks a bold direction for the future of the Aurora Fox, rooted in community, connection and powerful storytelling.

Set in Memphis Lee's Pittsburgh coffee shop, "Two Trains Running" follows a group of regulars navigating a neighborhood on the brink of redevelopment. Wilson's sharp, soulful writing reveals the hopes, disappointments and quiet strength of a community facing profound change — all delivered with the humor, heart and humanity that define his American Century Cycle.

August Wilson's "Two Trains Running" is not part of a subscription package. Current Seasin 41 Flexpass holders receive early access from **Oct. 15 to 19** , before public sales begin **Oct. 20** with early-bird pricing.

[Read more](https://www.aurorafoxartscenter.org/onstage/august-wilsons-two-trains-running)

event.title: Hank Williams: Lost Highway — AURORA FOX ARTS CENTER
event.description:
by Randal Myler and Mark Harelik

Directed by Abby Apple Boes

**Friday, Dec 4, - Sun, Dec. 27, 2026 \| Mainstage Theater**

Join us for something a little different! The spectacular musical biography of the legendary singer-songwriter frequently mentioned alongside Louis Armstrong, Robert Johnson, Duke Ellington, Elvis and Bob Dylan as one of the great innovators of American popular music. The play follows Williams' rise from his beginnings on the Louisiana Hayride to his triumphs on the Grand Ole Opry to his eventual self-destruction at twenty-nine. Along the way, we are treated to indelible songs like "I'm So Lonesome I Could Cry," "Move It on Over" and "Hey, Good Lookin'," which are given fresh and profound resonance set in the context of Williams' life.

RECOMMENDED FOR: Age 14+

CONTENT ADVISORY: *contains mature themes and substance abuse*

[Read more](https://www.aurorafoxartscenter.org/onstage/lost-highway)

event.title: Bayonne
event.description:
Since his 2016 debut album *Primitives* , Bayonne has channeled his vast imagination into an elegant yet wildly experimental form of electronic pop, equal parts meditative and mesmerizing. In the making of his latest body of work, the Austin-based artist/producer/multi-instrumentalist otherwise known as Roger Sellers found himself in even greater need of an outlet for his kinetic creative impulses, thanks to an intense convergence of events in his personal life: his father's diagnosis with and eventual death from cancer, the end of a significant relationship, and an overwhelming struggle with depression and anxiety. Deeply informed by a deliberate transformation of his musical process, Bayonne's third full-length *Temporary Time* ultimately makes for his most expansive work to date—an album of both painfully raw introspection and otherworldly beauty.

[Read more](https://www.bluebirdtheater.net/events/detail?event_id=1413465)

event.title: Patrick Droney
event.description:
Singer/songwriter/producer Patrick Droney's third full-length project Made You Look arrives July 24 via Warner Records. The album comes after three defining years away — a meaningful pause in a career that spans three acclaimed records (2018's self-titled EP, 2021's State of the Heart, and 2023's Subtitles for Feelings), appearances on late night TV (Seth Meyers, Colbert), and hundreds of millions of streams. Made You Look is both an instruction and an admission at once — a record about paying attention in an era that forces us to always be somewhere else. In a culture built for speed, Droney slowed down, and the music is braver for it, both sonically and emotionally.

[Read more](https://www.bluebirdtheater.net/events/detail?event_id=1497626)
